summary: Fase 3 Recursos tested end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 pytest passing after fixing a real bug — /api/admin/blog/posts (POST and PATCH) never persisted the visibility field, so a post created with visibility=private leaked into /api/blog/posts (public). Added 'visibility': body.visibility to both admin_create_post doc and admin_update_post upd dict in server.py. After fix, private posts appear in /api/app/blog/posts (auth) but are correctly excluded from /api/blog/posts and /api/blog/posts/{slug} (404). Sober-counter endpoints (GET/start/reset/stop/date) all behave per spec, with future-date rejection (422 containing 'futura'), correct milestones_reached, milestones_notified cleared on PATCH date, and sober_counter never leaked in public GET /api/profile/{uid} (clear_public whitelist). Frontend: All required testids verified in /app/recursos, /app/recursos/contador, /app/recursos/blog, and /app/perfil. Tools point to https://sinadicciones.org/cl/... with target=_blank; blog cards link to https://plansobrio.com/blog/{slug} with target=_blank; sober widget correctly toggles between sober-widget-cta and sober-widget-active depending on backend state; recursos-link menu item points to /app/recursos.

critical.issue: Missing persistence of `visibility` field caused private posts to leak in /api/blog/posts. FIXED by testing agent (added 'visibility': body.visibility to both doc and upd dicts in server.py ~3745 and ~3796).

action_items: Optional: Consider also persisting `visibility` in a default value for pre-existing blog posts via a one-off migration script or a startup routine that sets visibility='public' when missing (currently relies on $ne 'private' which handles it, but explicit is safer).

Optional: /app/recursos/blog tag click test — my broad selector [data-testid^='blog-tag-'] matched the container 'blog-tag-filters' too. UI works, but consider renaming container to 'blog-tags-container' or 'blog-tag-list' to avoid prefix ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4074 lines; blog admin routes still duplicate fields between POST/PATCH doc dicts — extract a `_blog_doc_from_body(body, existing=None)` helper to prevent field-drift bugs like the visibility miss.

BlogPostIn.visibility default is 'public', but existing posts (created before this field) will lack it in DB. The public query `$ne: 'private'` handles it, but a startup migration setting visibility='public' where missing would be cleaner.
clear_public correctly uses a whitelist — sober_counter can never leak. Good pattern; keep enforcing it as new private fields are added.

rca of the issue: Fase 3 spec added `visibility: public|private` to BlogPostIn model. `_serialize_blog_post` and the public list/detail queries were updated to filter `$ne: 'private'`. However, admin_create_post and admin_update_post build the DB doc explicitly field-by-field and did not include `body.visibility`, so despite the model accepting the field, the value was silently dropped at write time. All new posts therefore had no `visibility` key in the DB, which — combined with the `$ne: 'private'` filter — meant everything was treated as public. Detection: created a POST via /api/admin/blog/posts with visibility=private, then queried /api/blog/posts and observed the slug present. Fix: added `'visibility': body.visibility` to both the insert doc (~line 3745) and the update set (~line 3796). Verified: 1) private post absent from /api/blog/posts, 2) /api/blog/posts/{slug} returns 404, 3) /api/app/blog/posts (auth) returns the post.
